description.text: Sets up the Sanduq workflow in a Spec Kit project: processes, decision reviewers, delegation, CI runners and evidence gate. Use when configuring a project, or for "initialize the workflow".
Scopes a GitHub issue and runs the managed lifecycle through Specify, Clarify and Plan. Use when starting work on an issue, or for "scope issue 42".
Applies the GitHub answers to a feature's clarification questions and continues the lifecycle. Use when the issue's questions are answered, or for "apply the answers".
Resumes an issue-bound feature at its earliest unfinished or stale stage. Use when a session was interrupted or paused, or for "continue the feature".

Runs the managed Ready and PR stages of an issue-bound feature: readiness checks, its one pull request, then the merge check. Use when every earlier stage has passed in a project with .specify/workflow.yml, or for "open the PR".

Prints the workflow record of one issue-bound feature: stage, active claim, receipts, blockers and evidence freshness; read-only. Use when asked which stage a feature is in or what blocks it, or for "where is this feature". For the live progress report use speckit.progress.status.
Checks the workflow's dependencies, policy, host commands, hooks and board setup. Use when a claim fails on setup or after an upgrade, or for "diagnose the workflow".
Repairs the workflow's managed hooks and presets from policy through Spec Kit. Use when doctor reports drift or after editing workflow.yml, or for "reconcile the workflow".
Runs the feature's affected test lanes locally as local evidence, never CI evidence. Use when testing before a push, or for "test what changed".
Summarizes recent GitHub Actions runs into job durations and fixed overhead. Use when CI is slow or runners change, or for "why is CI slow".
Explains a failing workflow evidence gate and its exact recovery recipe. Use when CI reports STALE_RECEIPT, or for "fix the gate".
Generates a compact brief for one task so a worker skips the full spec set. Use when assigning a task to a worker, or for "brief T012".
Applies queued pending artifact updates to contracts, data model or research. Use when Execute or Review ends, or for "apply pending updates".
Scopes a GitHub issue: checks prerequisites, sizes effort, asks how many sub-issues to create and publishes only an approved decomposition. Use when asked to scope, size, estimate or split an issue.
Runs as the before_specify hook: blocks Specify unless the issue has a fresh approved scope. Use when asked to specify an issue.
Runs as the after_specify hook: binds the new spec to its source issue. Use when asked to bind a spec after Specify.
Runs as the after_implement hook: refreshes Scope parent progress. Use when asked to update stale parent progress.
Redraws and validates the dependency plan with Illustrate after a Scope split is published. Use when asked to refresh the plan, or when the scope plan-pending marker exists.
Runs as an after_specify hook: starts the clarification round for the bound issue. Use when asked to clarify after Specify.
Runs as the before_plan hook: stops Plan unless the bound issue is Ready. Use when asked to plan an issue-bound spec.
Sets whether QA analysis and the QA manual are lifecycle gates or manual steps. Use when setting up Assure or asked to "make QA mandatory".
Adds missing E2E, screenshot, API sample, diagram and accessibility tasks to tasks.md. Use when asked to "check QA readiness" before implementation.
Generates or refreshes the development-only QA test manual from real evidence. Use when asked to "write the QA manual" after the tests pass.
Discovers the app, proposes a module map and scaffolds the audience-aware User Manual. Use when asked to 'create a user manual'.
Adds the feature's User Manual content and asset tasks to tasks.md. Use before implementation or when asked to 'add manual tasks'.
Updates the User Manual modules a feature affects, audits them and builds a private preview. Use when asked to 'update the manual'.
Builds versioned User Manual release notes, migration guides, HTML and PDFs. Use when asked to 'release the manual', never on a feature branch.
Generates the feature CHANGELOG and details doc, then creates or updates the pull request body; never merges. Use when asked to 'write the PR description'.
Fixes or answers unresolved PR review comments after approval, then pushes and resolves threads. Use when asked to 'address review comments'.
Sets up GitHub Project sync once per repository, mapping lifecycle phases to Status columns. Use when asked to 'connect the project board'.
Moves the feature issue to a lifecycle phase on the GitHub Project; standalone, it also creates and closes task sub-issues. Use when asked to 'sync the board'.
Draws 44 diagram and chart types (architecture, sequence, ER, Gantt) as themed HTML with inline SVG. Use when asked to "draw a diagram".
Exports an Illustrate diagram to SVG, transparent PNG, animated SVG or GIF; the HTML stays the source. Use when asked to "export the diagram".
Initializes, selects, validates or creates the project Illustrate color and font theme. Use when asked to "set the diagram theme".
Redraws a draw.io, Mermaid or Excalidraw file as a themed Illustrate diagram with a fidelity ledger. Use when asked to "import this .drawio".
Sets up memory hooks, checks and guards with archiving off. Use when asked to "set up project memory".
Queues an implemented feature for archival after merge. Use when asked to "queue it for archival".
Archives verified features into project memory as a reviewed delta. Use when asked to "archive the feature".
Processes merged pending archives and resumes interrupted runs. Use when asked to "process archives".
Records approval of the archive policy so archives run automatically. Use when asked to "enable auto-archiving".
Consults product memory for the capabilities a change touches. Use when asked to "consult memory".
Reports archive approval, pending work and the next command. Use when asked "what is the archive status".
Creates the live progress report for the active feature and can install the Claude status line. Use when asked to 'track progress'.
Forces one progress snapshot now (hooks already refresh it); never marks the feature complete. Use when asked to 'refresh the progress report'.
Prints the one-line progress state (stage, lanes, blockers, decisions), or JSON with --json. Use when asked to 'show progress status'.
Sets the progress report look from a preset, the Illustrate theme or a theme file, or shows it. Use when asked to 'change the report theme'.
Writes the progress projection as deterministic Markdown or JSON at no model cost. Use when asked to 'export the progress report'.
